answers.core:
Because the entire point of the feature is to improve the asset library itself.  
This requires foundational changes to Godot’s infrastructure and the introduction of a new system to support large, high-quality assets.  
This is a core ecosystem improvement that benefits all developers and cannot be reliably handled as a simple plugin.
answers.workaround:
No.  
This cannot be solved with a script because it requires:
– a large curated asset database  
– infrastructure for previewing/downloading assets  
– UI integration inside the editor  
– backend support for creators to upload/update assets  
These cannot be implemented with a few lines of script or a simple editor plugin.
